Search and measurement questions

What should we measure?+

Measures depend on your goals and tracking setup. Relevant enquiries and customer actions are more useful than treating traffic alone as success.

Can you guarantee rankings or AI recommendations?+

No. The service covers defined work, transparent measurement, and ongoing decisions based on available evidence.

Is advertising spend included?+

Advertising budgets are separate from management fees. Channels, creative assets and tracking are agreed in the campaign scope.
